verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਹੈ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: raag dhokh niradhokh hai raaj jog varatai varataaraa|

en.bdb: Away from attachment and jealousies he has adopted rajyoga (The supreme yoga).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਵਾਚਾ ਕਰਮਣਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: manasaa vaachaa karamanaa maram na jaapai apar apaaraa|

en.bdb: None can know the mystery of his mind, speech and actions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਦੈਆ ਦਾਨਿ ਦੇਵਸਥਲੁ ਸਤਿਸੰਗੁ ਉਧਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhaataa bhugataa dhaiaa dhaan dhevasathal satisa(n)g udhaaraa|

en.bdb: He is bestower ( unattached) enjoyer, and he has created holy congregation which is equal to the abode of gods.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: sahaj samaadh agaadh bodh satigur sach savaaranahaaraa|

en.bdb: He remains absorbed in innate poise; the master of unfathomable intellect,  and being the true Guru he sets every one's disordered life in order.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਜੁਹਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: gur amarahu gur raamadhaas jotee jot jagai juhaaraa|

en.bdb: From the flame of Guru Amar Das the flame of Guru Ram Das has been lighted. I salute him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਝਰਧਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat gur sikh hoi anahadh baanee nijharadhaaraa|

en.bdb: By becoming a disciple of the Guru and merging his consciousness into the Divine Word, he has tasted the ever-flowing stream of the unstruck melody.
Sitting on the throne of Guru, he has become manifest in the world
